summary: Frontend-only regression for the ARSHNAZ 'Mind redesign' iteration (Jan 2026). Verified: login, module seeding, /app/mind home at 1440/853/390/320px, mood slider save + status + button-label flip + reload persistence, busy-mind draft persistence + continue-draft card + path-through-prefill to /app/thoughts and /app/worry, think-mode short (ABC) toggle, Calm page sections and quick-breathing autostart, /app/mind/trends chips/empty-state/weekly-review/screeners/details/AI preview dialog (opened but NOT confirmed), /app/smart?source=mind actions link, redirects /app/socratic -> /app/mind and /app/abc -> /app/thoughts?mode=short, sidebar (Mind group has no Socratic/ABC entries; Growth has 'ارزش‌ها و اهداف'; Health group with 'سیکل پریود' is defined in SidebarNavSections.tsx), Ctrl+K palette has no Socratic entry, /app/values accessible, and regression pages /today /pomodoro /checkin /crisis load. Overall ~98% PASS. One minor regression: /app/screener redirects back to /today (route appears missing/renamed).

rca_of_issue: /app/screener landing on /today: no screener route is registered in src/App.tsx under /app/screener. The sidebar/menu may have moved screeners into the /app/mind/trends 'mind-screeners' block (visible in trends page as expected). The 404 handler auto-redirects unknown /app/* paths to /today. Fix: either register a <Route path='screener' ... /> or add an explicit alias in retiredFeatures.ts mapping /app/screener -> /app/mind/trends#mind-screeners.
